# T3DOTM - ReXGlue Recompiled Project
#
# SDK boilerplate lives in generated/rexglue.cmake.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(T3DOTM LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# generated/rexglue.cmake (regenerated by codegen) wires codegen into the
# build via $<TARGET_FILE:rex::rexglue>. The nfsmw-nx SDK base predates that
# target, so provide it manually pointing at the host tool (rebuilt from the
# layered-VFS SDK, NOT the stock rexglue-release binary). Host only: a cross
# build (Switch) must NOT run codegen (the tool is a host program that cannot
# run there) and must instead consume the already-generated sources.
if(NOT TARGET rex::rexglue AND NOT REXGLUE_PLATFORM_SWITCH)
    add_executable(rex::rexglue IMPORTED)
    set_target_properties(rex::rexglue PROPERTIES
        IMPORTED_LOCATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../repos/nfsmw-nx/sdk/out/win-amd64/rexglue.exe")
endif()

include(generated/rexglue.cmake)

# Sources
set(T3DOTM_SOURCES
    src/main.cpp
    src/switch_stdio_lock_stubs.cpp
)

if(WIN32)
    add_executable(T3DOTM WIN32 ${T3DOTM_SOURCES})
else()
    add_executable(T3DOTM ${T3DOTM_SOURCES})
endif()

rexglue_setup_target(T3DOTM GPU_PLUGINS xenos)

# Nintendo Switch: T3DOTM.nro next to the ELF. On the SD card it goes in
# sdmc:/switch/T3DOTM/ with the game_root/ folder extracted beside it
# (src/T3DOTM_app.h looks for it there), matching the UnleashedRecomp-NX
# shipping layout.
if(REXGLUE_PLATFORM_SWITCH)
    # Diagnostic startup bisect markers (see file header). Only for Switch.
    target_sources(T3DOTM PRIVATE src/startup_bisect_markers.cpp)
    # LTO on the game code and the app (not on the SDK libraries). The
    # generated source is large: the whole-program phase does not fit in RAM
    # (lto1.exe ran out of memory allocating 631168 bytes with 2 parallel
    # whole-program jobs while ~13 GB was free), so it runs single-process --
    # -flto=1 keeps one WPA lto1 process (about half the peak RAM) together
    # with -flto-partition=balanced.
    option(T3DOTM_LTO "LTO en el codigo del juego y de la app (Switch)" ON)
    if(T3DOTM_LTO)
        foreach(objetivo T3DOTM_recomp T3DOTM)
            if(TARGET ${objetivo})
                target_compile_options(${objetivo} PRIVATE -flto -fno-fat-lto-objects)
            endif()
        endforeach()
        target_link_options(T3DOTM PRIVATE -flto=1 -flto-partition=balanced)
    endif()
    # T3DOTM_register.cpp is a 100k+ line pure symbol-registration table with
    # no hot code. -O3 makes GCC spend hours on it; add -O0 on top (appended
    # after the global -O3, and GCC honors the last -O switch on the command
    # line). APPEND keeps the recomp options from generated/rexglue.cmake.
    set_property(SOURCE
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/default/T3DOTM_register.cpp"
        APPEND PROPERTY COMPILE_OPTIONS "-O0")
    # Homebrew menu icon: a 256x256 PNG, as elf2nro expects.
    set(T3DOTM_ICON "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../icon_T3.png")
    set(T3DOTM_ICON_ARG)
    if(EXISTS "${T3DOTM_ICON}")
        set(T3DOTM_ICON_ARG ICON "${T3DOTM_ICON}")
    endif()
    rexglue_switch_add_nro(T3DOTM
        NAME "Transformers: Dark of the Moon"
        AUTHOR "mzy1996"
        VERSION "0.1.0"
        ${T3DOTM_ICON_ARG})
    # Fold the NRO rodata segment into data (RELR safety fix). The recompiled
    # image keeps ~596 RELR targets in the .rodata region; NRO headers carry no
    # per-segment permissions, so loaders (hbmenu) map "rodata" read-only and
    # libnx's RELR pass Data Aborts before any log is written. The project link
    # script (tools/switch/switch.ld) marks that PT_LOAD Read|Write already;
    # this post-build step applies the same policy to the NRO header so the
    # whole region is mapped Read|Write. Layout and bytes stay unchanged.
    # DISABLED: hbl 2.4.5 rejects rodata_size=0 with InvalidSize (0x295B).
    # add_custom_command(TARGET T3DOTM POST_BUILD
    #     COMMAND python "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../tools/switch/nropatch_rodata.py"
    #         "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:T3DOTM>/T3DOTM.nro"
    #     COMMENT "Folding NRO rodata segment into data (RELR-safe)"
    #     VERBATIM)
endif()
